target_method: Fixed source-space torso anchor transformed by unchanged pose; Gaussian sigma 4 frames; global fixed scale fitted once over the entire orbit.

geometry_adaptation.method: Closed three-dimensional posterior oral shell attached to the existing outer lip contour, in mouth group 13. Original front cavity, teeth, source surfaces, group count and all pose matrices are unchanged.
geometry_adaptation.exterior_color: Existing lip color at its seam; inverse-distance samples of source-derived head/jaw/neck skin colors on the posterior shell.
geometry_adaptation.limitations: A V2 authored closure for side and rear viewing, not newly recovered source anatomy. Requires no-Z whole-orbit validation after cache construction.
